name: SAM.gov
summary: US federal contract opportunities (solicitations, presolicitations, award notices) and the registry of entities registered to do business with the US government, from the GSA's SAM.gov APIs.

api_key.description: A personal public API key from the Account Details page of a SAM.gov account. Sent as the api_key query parameter.

notes: Daily request limits depend on the account: a personal key of a non-federal user with no SAM.gov role gets 10 requests a day; with a role, or a federal user, 1,000.
This entry reads public data only; FOUO and sensitive entity data need a federal system account.

endpoints.name: Search contract opportunities
endpoints.summary: Federal contract notices posted in a date range, filtered by type, NAICS, set-aside, agency, place or deadline.

postedFrom.description: Start of the posted-date range, MM/dd/yyyy.

postedTo.description: End of the posted-date range, MM/dd/yyyy; at most one year after postedFrom.

ptype.description: Notice type: u justification, p presolicitation, a award notice, r sources sought, s special notice, o solicitation, g sale of surplus property, k combined synopsis/solicitation, i intent to bundle (DoD).

organizationName.description: Department or sub-tier name; general text search.

typeOfSetAside.description: Set-aside code, e.g. SBA, 8A, WOSB, VSA.

rdlto.description: Response-deadline range end, MM/dd/yyyy; at most one year after rdlfrom.

limit.description: Records per page, at most 1000; the default is 1, so set it.

notes: Returns only the latest version of each notice. The description field is a link that needs api_key appended to download the text.

endpoints.name: Search registered entities
endpoints.summary: Entities registered in SAM (contractors and grantees) by UEI, CAGE code, name, NAICS, state or free text, with registration and core data.

ueiSAM.description: 12-character UEI, or up to 100 of them.

legalBusinessName.description: Legal business name, partial or complete.

cageCode.description: 5-character CAGE code, or up to 100 of them.

samRegistered.description: Yes for registered entities (the default), No for ID-assigned-only entities.

physicalAddressProvinceOrStateCode.description: State or province of the physical address.

includeSections.description: Comma-separated sections: entityRegistration, coreData, assertions, pointsOfContact, repsAndCerts, integrityInformation, or All (which leaves out integrityInformation).

notes: At most 10 records per page and only the first 10,000 records of a result; page times size cannot exceed 10,000.
Adding format or emailId turns the call into an asynchronous bulk extract; this entry does not cover that flow.
